target_process: Seasonal/hydrological velocity change (precipitation–groundwater) superimposed on volcanic medium changes
best_practice_note: Foundational 'passive image interferometry': one permanent station suffices; seasonal hydrological signal must be separated from volcanic

target_process: Pre-eruptive edifice change from magma pressurization (eruption precursor)
region_site: Piton de la Fournaise, La Réunion
coda_window_s: n/r (slope of dtau vs tau; short scanning window)
stack_scheme: Daily stacks referenced to long-term stack
best_practice_note: First demonstration that ~0.05% pre-eruptive drops are continuously detectable from noise with weeks of lead time

target_process: dv/v tracking inflation (decrease), deflation (increase) and caldera collapse (strong drop)
region_site: Piton de la Fournaise, La Réunion
best_practice_note: Quasi-real-time CWI workflow distinguishing inflation, deflation, collapse phases

target_process: Methodology: error/bias quantification of dv/v measurement (PdlF application)
region_site: Piton de la Fournaise, La Réunion
stack_scheme: Daily stacks vs long-term reference; error from coherence
best_practice_note: Reference for estimating MWCS errors and choosing coda windows to limit bias

target_process: Pre/co-eruptive elastic (dv/v) and scattering (decoherence) changes; localization of changes
region_site: Piton de la Fournaise, La Réunion
stack_scheme: Daily stacks, referenced; coda at increasing lapse times
depth_sensitivity: Early coda = shallow (surface waves); late coda = deeper (body waves)
best_practice_note: Couples dv/v with waveform decoherence and lapse-time depth sensitivity to image/locate changes (shallow vs deep)

target_process: Inter-eruption magmatic/hydrologic velocity change
stack_scheme: Stack across several hundred repeating-earthquake families (multiplets)
dvv_amplitude: Generally <1% (≈2% spread over years if read as Vs change)
best_practice_note: Coda-wave interferometry on repeating-earthquake families builds a continuous single-station inter-eruption record

target_process: Velocity changes during 2004–2008 eruption; conduit/plumbing dynamics
stack_scheme: Combines repeating-earthquake CWI with ambient-noise interferometry
best_practice_note: Cross-validates coda-wave and ambient-noise dv/v during an eruption

target_process: Pre-eruptive velocity decrease, corrected for rainfall/pore-pressure
region_site: Piton de la Fournaise, La Réunion
stack_scheme: Daily stacks vs reference; network-averaged dv/v
uncertainty_treatment: dv/v corrected for rainfall pore-pressure to improve detectability of small drops
best_practice_note: Environmental (rainfall) correction is essential — hydrological dv/v is comparable to the pre-eruptive signal

target_process: Pre-eruptive velocity drop (intrusion/edifice damage) on sparse networks
region_site: Piton de la Fournaise, La Réunion (method also re Kawah Ijen)
best_practice_note: Single-station cross-component (SC) more stable than autocorrelation at low freq; one station 3.65 km from vent still detected the drop

target_process: dv/v tracking summit inflation/deflation (radial tilt); magma pressurization
coda_window_s: 30 s window, min lag = interstation dist / 0.8 km/s
stack_scheme: Daily NCFs stacked over 3-day moving window
dvv_amplitude: Order ~0.1%; long-term trend cross-correlation -0.73 with tilt
uncertainty_treatment: weighted dt-t regression; coherence>0.65, err<0.1 s thresholds
best_practice_note: ~231 pairs from 22 vertical-component summit stations; first robust multi-year dv/v–deformation correlation using lava-lake tremor as repeating source

target_process: Velocity reduction from pressurized volcanic fluids during 2016 Kumamoto earthquake; post-event depressurization recovery
depth_sensitivity: Magma body inferred ~3–10 km at Aso
best_practice_note: Spatial dv/v mapping separates volcano fluid signal from fault-zone damage; stretching vs MWCS compared

target_process: Stress sensitivity of dv/v during volcano deformation (geodetic source); depth localization
depth_sensitivity: Changes concentrated in shallow structure (higher bands shallower)
best_practice_note: Multi-band analysis localizes velocity change to shallow structure and ties it to strain from a geodetic deformation source

target_process: Search for precursory velocity change before large dome collapse; sensitivity to tectonic quakes/environment
best_practice_note: Establishes ~0.05% detection floor via pair averaging; reports ABSENCE of precursor before July 2015 collapse (important null result)

target_process: Volcanic unrest / phreatic eruption; separating coseismic and seasonal medium changes
best_practice_note: Single-station measurements separate volcanic, coseismic, and seasonal contributions over a decade

target_process: Intense pressurization accompanying paroxysmal lava-fountain eruptions
components: Three-component autocorrelation (ZZ, EE, NN averaged per station)
depth_sensitivity: Near-field; varies with station proximity to vents
uncertainty_treatment: cross-coherence + squared misfit; reject dt err>0.1 s or coh<0.6
best_practice_note: Single-station autocorrelation captures pressurization at summit stations even on sparse networks

target_process: Pre-eruptive velocity decrease (~10 days before onset); edifice damage/pressurization
best_practice_note: Separates stable microseism band (0.1–0.2 Hz) from volcanic-tremor band (0.3–1 Hz) to distinguish medium vs source-noise effects

target_process: Crustal response to 2014 Bárðarbunga–Holuhraun dike intrusion (volumetric strain) + seasonal loading
depth_sensitivity: Multi-band probing across depths, including depths where geodesy is insensitive
best_practice_note: Demonstrates linear dv/v–volumetric-strain relation in compressional/dilatational dike regions; multi-frequency depth probing

target_process: Summit inflation (dv/v increase) then edifice damage + Upper East Rift Zone intrusion (decrease) before 2018 eruption
depth_sensitivity: Frequency-dependent depth discrimination across upper crust
best_practice_note: Three frequency bands separate response to earthquake shaking vs deep magmatic intrusion and discriminate depth

target_process: Velocity changes during 2018 caldera collapse; growth of caldera ring fault toward surface
stack_scheme: Coda Wave Interferometry with Repeating Earthquakes (CWIRE), per-cluster pairs
depth_sensitivity: Short-term changes distributed in depth; long-term changes concentrated near surface
best_practice_note: Repeating-earthquake CWI resolves depth partitioning of fast (deep) vs slow (shallow) velocity changes during collapse

target_process: Volcanic, tectonic and environmental (groundwater) influences on velocity over 22 yr
stack_scheme: Long-term NCF stacks; many dv/v series on a common grid
dvv_amplitude: dv/v increase during 2004–2008 crisis; seasonal cycles (% n/r)
best_practice_note: 22+ yr continuous ambient-wavefield monitoring; spatial imaging of many dv/v series separates volcanic/tectonic/hydrologic signals

target_process: Seasonal snow loading vs volcanic processes; eruption–seasonality link
depth_sensitivity: Inversion places changes in upper ~300 m
best_practice_note: Cross-wavelet dv/v with depth inversion; seasonal snow signal must be removed before attributing changes to volcanic processes

target_process: Magma-reservoir inflation/deflation (400–500 day cycle); coseismic drops; areal-strain coupling
dvv_amplitude: ~1–2% (range -1% to +3%); rapid drops after large earthquakes incl. 2011 M9.1 Tohoku-oki
best_practice_note: 17-yr, 24-station record isolates ~400–500 day periodic dv/v tied to areal strain from magma inflation/deflation, separate from coseismic drops
